categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in power generation and supply, including coal-fired power, hydropower, wind power, photovoltaic (solar) power, and thermal power production and sales. It also engages in coal sales, power grid operations, new energy projects, high-tech and environmental protection industries, and related technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced coal-fired power technologies with low carbon transformation initiatives, including flexible operation and energy-saving upgrades. It utilizes hydropower development with ecological-friendly designs and digital tools for planning. The renewable energy segment focuses on wind and solar power with cost control and market competitiveness. The company also invests in R&D for clean coal technologies, carbon capture and storage (CCUS), and digital management platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include regional and provincial power grid companies across China, industrial parks, urban communities, and energy users in 29 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. The company serves the electricity market with a focus on stable supply and market-oriented electricity trading, including participation in nationwide unified power markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide in China, covering 29 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions. Major operational bases include Northeast China, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest China, and Southwest China, with significant assets in regions like Inner Mongolia, Zhejiang, Anhui, Shanxi, and Xinjiang.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, focusing on power generation and supply. It also engages in coal procurement and sales, power grid operations, and energy services, positioning itself as a comprehensive energy provider within the national energy system.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating the green and low-carbon transition, expanding renewable energy capacity, enhancing coal-fired power flexibility and efficiency, and integrating into new energy systems. R&D focuses on clean coal technologies, CCUS, digitalization of power plant management, and advanced renewable energy technologies to maintain technological leadership and support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of electricity and heat, including market-based electricity trading and long-term contracts. Additional revenue streams include coal sales, government subsidies, investment income from equity holdings, and service fees related to energy management and technical consulting.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As a subsidiary of the State-owned China Energy Investment Corporation, the company is a leading national power producer with a strong position in coal-fired and renewable energy sectors. It competes with other major state-owned power companies such as China Huaneng Group, China Huadian Corporation, and China Datang Corporation, leveraging its diversified energy portfolio and strategic integration within the national energy framework.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 179.18 billion in 2024, with a slight decrease of 1% year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders increased significantly by 75.28% to RMB 9.83 billion. Total assets reached nearly RMB 494 billion, reflecting steady growth and substantial scale as a major power generation enterprise in China.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes reliable energy supply with a diversified energy mix, including a growing share of clean and renewable energy. It differentiates itself through technological innovation in low-carbon coal power, integrated energy services, and strong market adaptability in the evolving national power market. Its strategic alignment with national energy security and green development policies enhances its competitive advantage.
